page: Amazon Web Services is4gen.2xlarge is an arm64 storage-optimized instance running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The instance features an AWS Graviton Neoverse-N1 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, providing 8 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core and no simultaneous multithreading. Memory provision stands at 48.0 GB, yielding a 1:6 vCPU-to-memory ratio (6.0 GB per core). A key architectural feature is the inclusion of 7,500 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage bundled directly into the hardware configuration. It includes a 12 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile and contains no GPU accelerators.

Benchmark analysis shows solid multi-core throughput alongside modest single-core compute. The Neoverse-N1 cores achieve an average stress-ng multi-core score of 12,134.02 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 5,346.0, whereas single-core metrics lean lower, such as a Geekbench single-core score of 950.0 and weak compression speeds (gzip single-threaded compression at 20.3 GB/sec). Memory bandwidth reaches 123.76 GB/sec for large un-cached blocks and 472.98 GB/sec for small cached reads. Workload-specific tests reveal average throughput in key I/O areas, producing 9.55 million Redis SET operations per second and 9.58 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

Given its combination of 7.5 TB of local NVMe SSD storage and 48.0 GB of RAM, the is4gen.2xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for IOPS-intensive applications requiring substantial high-speed temporary or cache storage. It avoids the recurring external network storage costs associated with attached block devices. Tradeoffs include low single-threaded instruction performance and absence of vector acceleration units like AVX or AMX, rendering it inefficient for CPU-based machine learning inference.

The is4gen.2xlarge is well fitted for distributed storage clusters, NoSQL databases, log analysis engines, caching tiers like Redis, and intermediate data processing pipelines requiring fast local SSD storage alongside balanced core counts.
description: Amazon Web Services is4gen.2xlarge is a storage-optimized instance powered by an 8-core AWS Graviton Neoverse-N1 arm64 processor at 2.5 GHz without multithreading. It features 48.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:6 core-to-memory configuration, accompanied by 7,500 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage and a 12 Gbps network baseline. Synthetic testing indicates balanced multi-core scaling, achieving 12,134.02 in multi-core stress-ng tests and handling 9.55 million Redis SET operations per second, though single-core compute and compression metrics remain comparatively weak. The hardware package lacks GPU accelerators and specialized x86 vector extensions, focusing its value on local I/O density. This profile provides efficient cost utility for applications requiring direct high-capacity disk storage without network storage overhead, serving workloads such as distributed file systems, NoSQL databases, data ingestion layers, and search index caching.
